diagnostics.help: treat metallic-roughness output as a compatibility preview until the PBR visual gate closes
diagnostics.message: PBR is reported as degraded until GPU material, texture, and IBL shading are proven

diagnostics.help: use MaterialDesc::* as scalar preview shortcuts, or claim Assets::material_presets() only for lanes with Round E reference, browser, and capability row proof artifacts
diagnostics.message: Complete real-world material presets are in fallback on this lane: chrome, brushed_steel, clearcoat_plastic, clear_glass, frosted_glass, leather, rubber, and satin require approved material proof before they can be claimed as complete

diagnostics.help: query the active backend before enabling shadow-dependent presentation; GPU-device WebGPU/WebGL2/native lanes carry receiver-darkening proof
diagnostics.message: Directional shadows are degraded on CPU/reference lanes without GPU shadow-map receiver proof

diagnostics.help: use unshadowed point lights or bake shadowing into assets until the point-shadow gate closes
diagnostics.message: Point shadows are disabled until cube-map shadow rendering and receiver sampling are implemented

diagnostics.help: use unshadowed spot lights or bake shadowing into assets until the spot-shadow gate closes
diagnostics.message: Spot shadows are disabled until projected spot shadow maps and receiver sampling are implemented

diagnostics.help: do not claim clear_glass/frosted_glass as complete real-world materials until the Round E glass and OIT proof artifacts pass for this backend
diagnostics.message: Physical glass transmission is degraded until the lane proves scene-color transmission, IOR/thickness refraction, rough-transmission blur, and transparency ordering

diagnostics.help: treat output as sRGB unless a recorded canvas probe reports Display P3 for the active backend
diagnostics.message: Wide-gamut output needs a browser surface color-space probe before Display P3 can be claimed

diagnostics.help: use CPU culling diagnostics and draw statistics until the GPU culling gate closes
diagnostics.message: GPU culling is disabled until the compute path writes real culling decisions
